Description

Single Sponsor Associate Clinical Project Director (Program Manager) - 3 days in the Dublin office

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Typically manages a team of direct reports and may have indirect reports. Plays a leadership role in team member recruitment, on-boarding and leads ongoing training and coaching of team members.
May provide input into strategic and operational short- and long-range therapeutic area / functional area plans as appropriate, including supporting alignment and communications to other team members upon implementation.
Champions Values and Leadership Commitments.
Responsible for overseeing the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility.
Responsible for leading or otherwise overseeing study teams related to assigned studies.
Proactively manages vendor engagement for appropriate third-party oversight at the study-level, including proactive governance.
Proactively manages stakeholder relationships at the study-level.
Proactively manages oversight of clinical study execution, including developing operational strategies for the study to optimize execution.
May actively contribute to and/or represent Clinical Operations at sub-teams as applicable, including providing input and support to Associate Directors / Directors as needed.
Acts as a manager of managers and individual contributors with a People First approach that focuses on employee engagement, development and team health.
Responsible for the resource management of assigned studies, including an ongoing assessment of resource needs and optimal deployment of resources to support a fluid ‘One Ops’ workforce.
Effectively participates and engages in Clinical Operations and/or cross-functional change initiatives.
Leads and/or engages in Clinical Operations-specific change initiatives, typically therapeutic area- or functional area- specific.
May have business process owner (BPO) responsibilities and/or serve as a subject matter expert for Clinical Operations processes.
Encourages an innovative mindset by championing new ideas and initiatives that incorporate best practices, external benchmarking and standardization across Clinical Operations.
Ensures team’s work complies with established practices, policies and processes, and any regulatory or other requirements.
Experience needed.
BA / BS / RN with end to end program management experience, with a solid background in Clinical Trial Management or Clinical Project Management.
Operating at a high level in a cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in CRO or Pharma, including multiple years’ experience leading and managing study management or project teams.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

Clinical Operations is responsible for the worldwide execution of all Phase I - IV clinical trials across therapeutic areas. Clinical Operations plays a key role in ensuring all clinical trials are performed in accordance with applicable SOPs, company policies and regulatory guidelines to provide timely and high-quality clinical data that supports global registration and commercialization of our client's products. This individual will manage a team of direct and potentially indirect reports. Oversee and be responsible for the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility. You may act as the business process owner (BPO) and/or serve as a subject matter expert for Clinical Operations processes. You will encourage an innovative mindset by championing new ideas and initiatives and incorporating best practices, external benchmarking and standardization across Clinical Operations.

Job Description & Summary

We are seeking an experienced senior project leader (Associate Director / Director level) to join our Consulting practice, with a focus on the transport sector. The role offers the opportunity to lead multidisciplinary teams in the delivery of major transport and infrastructure programmes, providing strategic advisory, programme oversight and assurance services that support successful investment and delivery outcomes.

We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive experience advising on and leading major transport and infrastructure programmes. The successful candidate will play a key role in helping clients establish effective governance, manage programme risks and dependencies and deliver complex capital investments in line with strategic, financial and operational objectives.

Embrace the possibility to apply – at Grant Thornton we are constantly upskilling our staff. If you do not meet all of the listed requirements, please do not be discouraged from applying. We value a growth-oriented mindset and are dedicated to supporting you in reaching your full potential.

Roles & Responsibilities

Collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team to successfully deliver and manage projects across a range of key transport sector initiatives, including:

Project Management Delivery

Leading and advising on major transport and infrastructure programmes, supporting client organisations and senior leadership teams to strengthen programme governance, assurance and delivery performance across major capital investments.

Defining and driving projects across all stages of the project life cycle, from initiation to delivery, implementation and benefits realisation.

Establishing and overseeing programme-wide governance, monitoring and assurance frameworks while managing complex interfaces, interdependencies and multi-contract delivery arrangements across large-scale infrastructure programmes.

Leading and mentoring multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaboration across client organisations, delivery partners, contractors, regulators and other key stakeholders.

Developing and maintaining robust integrated assurance strategies encompassing governance, risk, cost, schedule, design, change control, benefits realisation and programme performance.

Leading the assessment of procurement and delivery models, supporting clients in identifying appropriate approaches for the successful delivery of complex infrastructure and capital investment programmes.

Producing executive, board-level and stakeholder reporting, translating complex programme information into clear, evidence-based insights to support decision-making.

Embedding proactive risk management, programme controls and governance practices that support successful programme delivery and long-term investment outcomes.

Business Development

Building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across the transport and infrastructure sector, positioning Grant Thornton as a strategic advisor and partner of choice.

Leading client engagement activities, facilitating discussions, workshops and strategic planning sessions to identify client priorities, shape solutions and develop opportunities for future collaboration.

Engaging senior executives, sponsoring organisations, government bodies, regulators, delivery agencies and industry stakeholders to support successful programme outcomes and sustainable client relationships.

Developing and expanding key client accounts across the across the transport and infrastructure sector, identifying opportunities to support clients in the delivery, oversight, governance and assurance of major capital investment programmes.

Leading and directing business development initiatives, including the preparation of proposals and tenders for new transport and infrastructure sector opportunities.

Collaborating with colleagues across Advisory and the wider firm to develop integrated solutions that address programme, infrastructure and investment challenges across the transport sector.

Skills and Experience

Education and Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or a related field; Master’s degree or relevant professional certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, APM) strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience working within large-scale capital investment and infrastructure delivery environments, including knowledge of programme governance, assurance frameworks and stage-gated approval processes.

8+ years' experience for Associate Director level, or 10+ years' experience for Director level, leading major transport and infrastructure programmes, with demonstrable expertise in programme governance, oversight, assurance, controls and the management of complex, multi-stakeholder delivery environments.

Skills and Competencies

Strong project and programme management experience leading and managing large multi-disciplinary teams comprised of clients, consultants, contractors and third-party delivery partners.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale transport and infrastructure programmes, including the establishment and operation of programme governance, oversight, monitoring, assurance and programme controls frameworks.
Extensive experience working across the transport and infrastructure sector, with a strong understanding of the governance, regulatory, funding and delivery landscape associated with major capital investment programmes.
Proven ability to direct and deliver complex, multi-stakeholder programmes across the full project lifecycle, from strategic planning and business case development through to implementation, assurance and benefits realisation.
Experience developing and implementing programme management approaches, including programme controls, risk management, change control, performance monitoring and continuous improvement frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives, programme sponsors and strategic stakeholders, shaping programme strategy while supporting successful delivery outcomes.
Strong organisational and multi-tasking abilities, with experience managing multiple priorities and delivering in complex, high-profile and fast-paced environments.
Significant experience in originating, leading and closing business development opportunities, including major transport and infrastructure sector tenders, frameworks and complex multi-stakeholder bids.
Expertise in senior stakeholder engagement, including government departments, transport authorities, infrastructure owners, regulators, delivery agencies and executive leadership teams.
An ability to balance big-picture thinking with acute attention to detail, translating long-term objectives into practical and deliverable solutions.
A strong interest in the future of transport and infrastructure, with an understanding of the opportunities and challenges associated with major capital investment, infrastructure delivery and programme assurance.
Experience developing and growing client accounts within the within the transport and infrastructure sector, with an established professional network and a strong understanding of market trends, client priorities and emerging investment opportunities.
A creative, problem-solving mindset and initiative-driven approach.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Media Team 👋

Trainline Media has proven advertiser demand and is now focused on building a larger, more predictable and repeatable sales engine. This role is central to that next phase, improving how the team plans, prioritises and manages sales performance so that sellers are focused on the right advertisers, generating high-quality opportunities and taking the actions needed to deliver revenue goals.

You will act as the commercial operating partner to Trainline Media's sales leadership and sales team, working backwards from revenue targets to define the pipeline, prospecting and sales activity required to deliver the plan. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with no direct reports, where success depends on combining rigorous analysis with strong commercial judgement, and on influencing experienced sellers without managing them directly. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Client Success to remove barriers to revenue.



In this role as the Sales Strategy & Operations Manager, you will...🚄

 - Translate annual and quarterly revenue targets into clear pipeline, prospecting and account-planning requirements, and run the sales-performance reviews that keep the team focused on the right actions.

 - Define and track the leading and lagging indicators used to manage commercial performance, giving leadership a clear view of capacity, productivity and revenue risk.

 - Build and maintain a prioritised prospect universe across advertisers, agencies and verticals, helping each seller focus on the accounts most likely to convert.

 - Own pipeline standards, forecasting methodology and commercial reporting, improving the quality of opportunity data in Salesforce and giving leadership an honest view of committed, likely and upside revenue.

 - Analyse where the team spends its time and reallocate effort toward the highest-value selling activity.

 - Introduce AI-assisted tools and reusable frameworks that sharpen pitches, personalise outreach at scale and simplify repetitive sales processes.

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Client Success to remove barriers to revenue and share learnings that improve how the team sells.

 - Build analytical dashboards that track sales effectiveness, productivity and the impact of the tools and processes you introduce.



We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Experience in sales strategy, sales operations, revenue operations or commercial planning, ideally within media, advertising or adtech.

 - Strong analytical skills, with fluency in pipeline, forecasting, conversion and productivity metrics.

 - Hands-on comfort with Salesforce and BI (business intelligence) reporting tools.

 - A track record of turning revenue targets into concrete plans, and using data to decide where a sales team should focus its time.

 - Real commercial judgement, understanding what makes a pitch land and helping sellers sharpen their story as well as their numbers.

 - Practical curiosity about AI and automation, ideally with examples of using new tools to make a sales team faster and more effective.

 - The credibility and influence to challenge and guide experienced sellers without managing them directly.

 - A highly organised, self-directed style, and genuine comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor.



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

Location: Dublin

Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: No

Business Area: Technology Consulting - Technology Delivery

Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you, we are counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

EY has a number of career opportunities available, and we are interested in meeting candidates who are looking for a new challenge, one where you can develop your range of skills significantly. Be that a move out of industry into practice, or from within practice into advisory services. We are looking for future leaders with a genuine creative vision and confidence to make it happen. Our opportunities will allow you to apply your expertise to a variety of projects whilst offering you excellent career progression opportunities.

The team and the opportunity

EY’s Technology Delivery team deliver technology-focused solutions based on industry best practices, processes, resources, tools and accelerators. Our teams deliver small-, medium- and large-scale multiyear programme transformations through Waterfall, Agile or adaptive hybrid approaches, based on customer requirements. Our teams have the depth and breadth of experience across a range of technology disciplines, utilising industry best practices, processes, resources, tools and accelerators in project and programme management, and vertically integrated governance with our world class technology delivery focussed PMO. This fundamentally underpins the delivery of cost optimised, stable, progressive IT infrastructure delivery and complex systems integrations supporting business growth. Our “Agile in a Box” service offering quickly establishes a delivery model using a combination of EY Accelerators, methodologies and Agile industry frameworks and toolsets enabling accelerated digital adoption as part of wider waterfall programmes & projects.

We are looking for senior leaders with experience in one or more of the following core areas:



- Programme management & technology delivery PMO
- SI Project Integration
- Agile Delivery
- Technical project management
- Infrastructure project management
- Operations & Service Management
- ServiceNow

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Manager, you will be expected to have experience in and be able to deliver against the following responsibilities both internally and externally.

Client Responsibilities



- End to end responsibility for the mobilisation, delivery and benefits of large scale complex strategic and/or transformative programmes in accordance with selected Project Management Methodologies.
- Plan, direct, and co-ordinate activities to manage and implement a change programme roadmap from mobilisation through to implementation by leading, directing and overseeing a large team of programme resources working across multiple workstreams and projects. 
- Influence and negotiate programme outcomes, often across multiple functions. Prepare and present analysis, insights and recommendation to assist defined governance forums and senior client stakeholders with decision making.
- Maintain focus so that programmes deliver on key priorities and dependencies and are managed to realise business benefits to agreed timelines. 
- Identify and advise on programme level decisions that influence significant programme direction and escalates decisions that cannot be resolved to the agreed governance forums.

Internal Responsibilities



- Understand our consulting service offerings and actively identify opportunities to better serve clients and be able to build meaningful external relationships with our clients and internal relationships across service lines. 
- Drawing on your skills and experience, you’ll create innovative insights for clients looking to leverage their vendor framework, improve their IT offerings, execute on Programme commitments and adapt methods and practices to fit operational teams and cultural needs, and contribute to thought leadership.
- Lead Technology Consulting engagements, managing team performance and commercials including conducting performance reviews and contributing to performance feedback for all levels of staff and managing engagement billings, and estimates to complete. 
- Develop people through effectively supervising, coaching, and mentoring all levels of staff.
- Understand, follow and lead staff in workplace policies and procedures.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To qualify for the role, you must have:



- A strong academic record including a third level degree, preferably in a business or IT related discipline, from a recognised third level institution.
- Additional relevant professional qualifications, such as PRINCE2®, PMP, PMBOK, SAFe or Diploma Level in Project Management or similar discipline from a recognised third level institution or accreditation body.
- At least 8 years’ experience working in a client facing role for a leading consulting or professional services company in delivery of large-scale complex change/transformation programmes or systems integration programmes or at least 10 years’ experience working for a leading company, in delivery of large-scale complex change/transformation programmes or systems integration programmes. 
- A minimum of 3 years’ relevant experience onsite within the UK&I region, in one or more of our focus industries including: Power & Utilities, Government & Public Sector, Technology, Media & Telecoms, Advanced Manufacturing / Industry 4.0, Consumer Products & Retail, Financial Services or Life Sciences.
- Experience in one or more technology areas including but not limited to ERP, CRM, AI, Digital Workplace, CX, Cloud Migration and/or integrations, Data & Analytics, RPA, Emerging Tech, IoT.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills – tailoring communications to suit a mix of audiences and ability to translate strategy into measurable business benefits. Experience communicating and presenting project information to project teams, finance and other stakeholders.
- Experience of working in a matrix managed organisation. 
- Experience in the establishment, training and management of teams comprised of client, contractors and client strategic partners.
- Have a track record of delivery within several large-scale IT transformation programmes. 
- Have experience in seeking the alignment of business and IT, operating across organisational and technology silos to drive common approaches, delivering sustainable, agile and re-usable solutions.
- Have a proven ability to be able to take a ‘big picture’ delivery and project management view as well as being able to work at a detailed level across a broad range of contract types and engagement approaches

Ideally, you will also have:



- Experience in tracking, monitoring, advising and maintaining status and actions across Project Budget, Risks, Issues, Dependencies and Benefits.
- Experience with Stakeholder Management and working collaboratively across IT, Finance and parts of the business to deliver project governance that meets client needs.
- A continued ambition to further develop and learn, fostering an interest in innovative technologies.
- A desire to identify new opportunities and help to create proposals to help solve our client’s most complex problems.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:



- Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:



- Pension
- Maternity & Paternity leave

Commercially astute with strong financial,operational, control and value delivery awareness.
Confident challenging legacy ways of working and driving standardisation.
Pragmatic, resilient, and outcome-focused, with the ability to maintain momentum in a complex delivery environment.
Strong attention to detail, particularly in relation to controls, auditability, data reconciliation, and readiness for go-live.

Description

The Network Delivery team is responsible for designing, building, and scaling telecommunications infrastructure to support Amazon’s Fulfillment infrastructure in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

We are seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to manage the design , acquisition and deployment of telecommunications services to support scaling and development of the Fulfillment Center Networks. This role will require market knowledge to develop market strategies that are operationally stable, scalable yet frugal. You will work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to develop project ideas into project plans, helping balance customer requirements with team requirements. You actively participate in design reviews, operational reviews, architecture discussions, and team planning. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions.

You are responsible for managing WAN infrastructure technology programs, that may require modification from defined templates to meet program goals. You work independently, seeking guidance as needed. You partner with other infrastructure teams to deliver difficult, cross-functional infrastructure build projects. You work directly with vendors, customers, partner teams, and (as needed) engineering teams. You have a solid understanding of the business problems, workflows, technologies, automation/tools, and the inter-dependencies that pertain to telecom programs. You make connections (to people and/or technologies) and make sure the right people are part of the conversation. You prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor WAN infrastructure build decisions. You partner effectively with technical managers to set project priorities, milestones, and drive delivery. You determine if success metrics are in place, and if not work to define them. You may be responsible for writing PR/FAQs, supporting OP1-2 efforts (including organizing/collecting data), and other strategic program documentation (e.g. Narratives). To meet timelines and minimize disruption to builder teams, you manage the overall schedule, proactively mitigate risks, and keep the scope of WAN infrastructure builds under control. You own program communication. You accelerate progress by driving crisp and timely decisions, clearing blockers (e.g., “Path to green”), escalating appropriately. You may apply process improvement methodologies (e.g., Agile, Lean, Kaizen analyses or other approach). You plan for the unexpected, making sure that systems (upstream and downstream) are not broken by changes related to the efforts you manage. You plan effectively to make sure projects deliver without wearing out key individuals and that outcomes are maintainable. You look for opportunities to incorporate needed system quality and operational excellence improvements into project plans.

Key job responsibilities

Serve as an interface for the entire life cycle (Order, budget and tracking) of wireless, voice and data circuits.

Obtain circuit quotes based on validated customer requirements.

Deep dive and define infrastructure requirements and dependencies for mature technical products.

Ensure circuit sizing, installation, and augmentation processes meet and comply with all Amazon polices and guidelines, specifically IT, Engineering and Information security.

Manage projects, identify risks, clearly & effectively communicate them to project stakeholders.

Ask the right technical questions to ensure appropriate trade-offs are made when delivering infrastructure builds.

Makes trade-offs: time vs. scope vs. cost. Clears blockers by defining problem solving and risk mitigation strategies, escalates appropriately. Accelerates progress by driving timely decisions.

Capable of adapting infrastructure builds to varying scenarios.

Works across teams. Influences customers, roadmap priorities, decisions and engineering processes. Influences external entities / vendors.

Facilitate conflict resolution through the full project cycle in disparate geographic locations.

Generate and deliver consolidated status reports for IT leadership and stakeholders.

Multiple team goals and program-related metrics, impacting a region.

Attend and actively participate in vendor quarterly business reviews across EU.

Improves project and process efficiency.

Optimizes cross-team processes to improve efficiency and delivery.

The OpsTech Networking Edge team builds the edge network infrastructure that powers Amazon fulfillment centers, transportation sites, and grocery operations worldwide. The team is responsible for WAN connectivity, SDWAN architecture, circuit availability, and edge security across 3,700 Amazon sites globally.

-  Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing large, complicated programs
-  Experience in infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking
-  Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
-  Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
-  Experience in project/program management
-  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent

-  Experience in leading complex, large-scale, IT, technical or engineering programs
-  Experience working with and managing third party vendors
-  Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements
-  Experience implementing process improvements
-  Experience in program management, logistics, operations, transportation, learning or a related field

- Outcomes-first - prioritises impact over activity

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

About The Team

The RevOps team owns the systems layer, operations & automation that supports Telnyx's growth engine. Historically, that meant administering 3rd party GTM tools used by humans: CRM, marketing automation, enrichment vendors, routing, campaign workflows, reporting, and vendor integrations.

That operating model is changing. Telnyx is increasingly building AI agents and automation that interact directly with the GTM stack. The systems team now needs to support both human-facing workflows and bot-facing infrastructure: clean data, reliable integrations, durable automations, documented process, and scalable operating patterns.

The Role

Telnyx is building the next generation of its go-to-market operating system: a trusted, automated systems layer where revenue teams and AI agents can work from clean data, clear business rules, and safe workflow surfaces.

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager, GTM Systems & Automation to lead the cross-functional programs that make that operating model real. You will connect business needs to technical execution across RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Data, Product, and Engineering. You will establish the roadmap, requirements, milestones, dependencies, decisions, controls, and adoption plans required to move complex systems work from ambiguity to durable outcomes.

This is a technical, hands-on program leadership role - not a ticket-queue administrator and not a traditional product management position. You will understand the systems deeply enough to challenge assumptions, debug workflows, define safe operating patterns, and partner credibly with engineers while remaining accountable for end-to-end program delivery.

What You'll Do



- Lead complex GTM systems, workflow-engineering, and automation programs from discovery and current-state mapping through design, delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
- Translate revenue workflows and user pain points into implementation-ready technical requirements, including system logic, data flows, integrations, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and measurable success criteria.
- Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap across CRM architecture, lead and account routing, enrichment, lifecycle automation, attribution, handoffs, service-order workflows, reporting dependencies, and AI-agent readiness.
- Create operating mechanisms that keep technical programs moving: intake and prioritization, decision forums, status reporting, risk escalation, change control, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
- Coordinate technical and business workstreams across RevOps, Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Security, and external vendors.
- Lead critical systems migrations and workflow redesigns with explicit cutover plans, data validation, business continuity, rollback paths, training, adoption measures, and support models.
- Define safe patterns for AI agents operating in GTM systems, including context, tools, permissions, approval gates, observability, auditability, exception handling, and human escalation.
- Make agentic execution your default operating mode, using AI agents to accelerate system discovery, technical requirements, prototyping, validation, documentation, QA, and implementation while helping shape GTM systems that are easier for both humans and agents to operate.
- Identify where manual work, vendor glue, or unclear ownership should become durable automation, owned system logic, internal tooling, or an agent-assisted workflow.
- Ensure every launch has documented business rules, system ownership, monitoring, support paths, downstream reporting impacts, and measurable operational outcomes.
- Manage vendor and tooling dependencies where they affect architecture, extensibility, reliability, security, cost, implementation timing, or roadmap decisions.

What You'll Bring



- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, GTM systems, revenue operations, business systems, GTM engineering, or a closely related technical operations discipline.
- A track record leading cross-functional systems programs with multiple business stakeholders and engineering or data teams.
- Strong hands-on fluency with Salesforce or HubSpot and a practical understanding of CRM data models, automation architecture, integrations, permissions, and reporting dependencies.
- Experience leading high-impact software migrations or workflow transformations involving critical end-user processes, data integrity, and minimal operational disruption.
- Ability to reason about APIs, webhooks, event and data flows, system integrations, automation tools, technical documentation, and implementation tradeoffs.
- Experience identifying and resolving integration failures, field-sync issues, routing errors, broken handoffs, data-quality problems, and workflow edge cases.
- Ability to go deeper than roadmap creation: you can reason through system architecture, data models, automation logic, edge cases, and what needs to be custom-built versus bought or configured.
- Strong program judgment: the ability to turn ambiguity into structure, make tradeoffs visible, drive decisions, and hold teams accountable without relying on formal authority.
- Clear written and verbal communication with executives, operators, analysts, administrators, and engineers.
- Comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment where the system, process, and ownership model may all be evolving.

Especially Valuable



- Experience designing systems where LLMs or agents are first-class users, including permissions, memory or context, human approval points, observability, and failure modes.
- Working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript, or lightweight scripting for analysis, prototyping, validation, debugging, or automation.
- Experience with marketing automation, sales engagement, enrichment, routing, customer-success, finance, or workflow-orchestration platforms.
- Experience in API-first SaaS, communications infrastructure, usage-based businesses, or technically complex B2B environments.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will:



- Build a current-state technical map of Telnyx’s GTM systems, including ownership, integrations, data flows, automations, dependencies, failure modes, active initiatives, and unresolved decision gaps.
- Establish a prioritized roadmap for the highest-leverage CRM, automation, data-quality, workflow-engineering, and AI-agent-readiness opportunities.
- Deliver implementation-ready requirements for priority initiatives, including system design, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, success metrics, launch criteria, adoption needs, rollback paths, and operational support models.
- Ship or directly drive measurable improvement in at least one high-friction workflow, such as routing, handoffs, CRM data quality, service orders, reporting, enrichment, lifecycle automation, or agent-assisted work.
- Use AI and automation in your own operating model to accelerate discovery, documentation, analysis, QA, stakeholder updates, and program execution.

Over Time, Success Means



- Telnyx has a clear product roadmap for its AI-native GTM operating system
- CRM, workflow, and automation investments are driven by user needs, business impact, and system scalability
- High-friction GTM workflows are continuously improved, shipped, measured, and iterated
- Repeated manual work becomes owned system logic, durable automation, or agent-assisted workflow
- Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and Engineering operate from cleaner data, clearer ownership, and more reliable systems
- Engineers spend less time on reactive GTM systems issues because requirements, ownership, and operating paths are clearer
- AI agents and automation can depend on clean data, safe integrations, clear permissions, reliable workflow rules, and well-defined approval boundaries
- Revenue teams spend less time maintaining systems and more time acting on trusted customer intelligence

Why This Role Matters

Telnyx is building the next version of its GTM operating system: one where revenue teams and AI agents can work from trusted data, clear workflows, and safe automation surfaces. This role owns the product direction for that future. You will help turn fragmented GTM processes into durable systems, reduce manual work, and build the foundation for a more intelligent, automated, and scalable revenue engine.

How We Work

We value ownership, technical curiosity, direct communication, and measurable outcomes. The strongest candidates are equally comfortable facilitating a cross-functional decision, reviewing a system design, tracing a broken workflow, documenting a launch plan, and ensuring that a change is adopted after it ships.

Our teams have the depth and breadth of experience across a range of technology disciplines, utilising industry best practices, processes, resources, tools and accelerators in project and programme management, and vertically integrated governance with our world class technology delivery focussed PMO. This fundamentally underpins the delivery of cost optimised, stable, progressive IT infrastructure delivery and complex systems integrations supporting business growth. Our “Agile in a Box” service offering quickly establishes a delivery model using a combination of EY Accelerators, methodologies and Agile industry frameworks and toolsets enabling accelerated digital adoption as part of wider waterfall programmes & projects.

- We specialise in PRINCE2, Agile, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and can adapt our delivery methodologies to each client’s preferred method of delivery.
- We offer industry-agnostic accelerators for the rapid deployment of a portfolio management office function to support small and large-scale transformation programmes.
- Our ServiceNow Specialists can help transform business with digital workflows for IT, Employees and Customers, enabling businesses to modernise operations, optimizing productivity, cost and resilience on a single platform.
- We have a dedicated Systems Integration team that deliver and manage programmes and projects, which are underpinned by systems development requiring complex systems integrations.
- We can quickly establish an agile delivery model using a combination of EY Accelerators, EY Methodologies and Agile industry-leading practices.
- Our Operations and Service Management team enhances, transforms, establishes, and executes operations based on leading service management frameworks.

New technologies and disruptive change are creating exciting opportunities: to work differently, to work better and to find new ways of creating value for us and the clients we serve. As part of our NextWave strategy, Technical Project Managers will provide Leadership, Support and Direction to support our client’s technology centric project and programmes. We are looking to recruit high performing individuals with a proven track record in Technical Project Management to be part of our leading and growing Technology Consulting business.

By joining the Technology Consulting team, you will be helping our clients solve a wide range of challenges - from the requirement to respond to the ever-changing demands of the market, to overseeing large and complex technical transformation projects/programmes that truly transform our clients ways of working, As part of this growing team, you will also get to help shape the innovative culture that makes EY such a great place to work.

- Maintain focus so that projects deliver on key priorities and dependencies and are managed to realise business benefits to agreed timelines.
- Identify and advise on project/programme level decisions that influence significant project direction and escalate decisions that cannot be resolved to the agreed governance forums.

Internal Responsibilities



- Understand all our consulting service offerings and actively identify opportunities to better serve clients and be able to build meaningful external relationships with our clients and internal relationships across service lines
- Drawing on your skills and experience, you’ll create innovative insights for clients looking to leverage their vendor framework, improve their IT offerings, execute on project commitments and adapt methods and practices to fit operational teams and cultural needs, and contribute to thought leadership
- Lead Technology Consulting engagements, managing team performance and commercials including conducting performance reviews and contributing to performance feedback for all levels of staff and managing engagement billings, and estimates to complete
- Develop people through effectively supervising, coaching, and mentoring all levels of staff
- Understand, follow and lead staff in workplace policies and procedures

- A strong academic record including a third level degree, preferably in a business or IT related discipline, from a recognised third level institution 
- Additional professional qualifications, such as PRINCE2®, PMP, PMBOK, SAFe or Diploma Level in Project Management or similar discipline from a recognised third level institution or accreditation body.
- At least 6 years’ experience working in a client facing role for a leading consulting or professional services company in delivery of large-scale complex technical projects or systems integration projects or at least 7 years’ experience working for a leading company, in delivery of technical projects or systems integration projects.
- A minimum of 3 years’ relevant experience onsite within the UK&I region, in one or more of our focus industries including: Power & Utilities, Government & Public Sector, Technology, Media & Telecoms, Advanced Manufacturing / Industry 4.0, Consumer Products & Retail, Financial Services or Life Sciences.
- Experience in one or more technology areas including but not limited to ERP, CRM, AI, Digital Workplace, CX, Cloud Migration and/or integrations, Data & Analytics, RPA, Emerging Tech, IoT.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills – tailoring communications to suit a mix of audiences. Experience communicating and presenting project information to project teams, finance and other stakeholders.

- Have experience in seeking the alignment of business and IT, operating across organisational and technology silos to drive common approaches, delivering sustainable, agile and re-usable solutions

 Business Engagement  

- Work with business and AI champions to shape use cases 
- Provide guidance on governance processes and approvals 
- Support awareness and adoption of AI policy and user guidelines 


Monitoring & Ongoing Oversight 

- Track approved initiatives and governance conditions 
- Coordinate incident escalation and governance reporting 
- Ensure oversight continues beyond initial approval 


Success Outcomes  

- All AI initiatives are supported, governed, approved, and tracked consistently 
- Complete visibility of AI activity via a maintained register and roadmap 
- Identify ways to reduced friction from idea to implementation 
- Strong documentation and audit readiness 
- Effective cross-functional coordination 


Candidate Profile  

- Experienced Technical Program Manager / PMO with strong governance capability 
- Strong stakeholder management across business and control functions 
- Comfortable operating in structured approval and risk environments 
- Excellent organisation, documentation, and communication skills 
- Experience in AI, data, or digital transformation is advantageous 


What We Offer 

- Comprehensive benefits package including our employee discount 
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression 
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment focused on innovation and growth 
- A chance to work in a fast-moving, high-impact, and customer-obsessed culture. 


 Dunnes Stores is an equal opportunity employer

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

The Backend teams at Trainline build the core of Trainline’s world class product. We create the journey search functionality that millions of our customers use on a daily basis, the eCommerce platform that provides a secure and seamless experience and we connect Trainline to over 270 travel operating companies, across 45 countries in Europe and the rest of the world. Each team has a targeted domain focus, ranging between customer accounts and notifications, journey search, bookings, payments, carriers’ integrations, real-time timetable information, and much more.

 - Deliver new functionality or features, using the most appropriate tools & techniques

 - Ensure quality is at the heart of everything you and your team do

 - Continuously improve the code base

 - Keep our customer as the number one priority

 - Actively identify blockers, boulders, time sinks and waste, and actively attempt to remove them

 - Make significant contribution to technical decisions

 - Act as a coach and mentor to others in the team

 - Take full ownership of the development lifecycle from code to production, including deployment and monitoring
   
    

Our Tech Stack 🔑

 - Languages & Frameworks: C# (.NET 6–10)

 - Databases: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL

 - Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, Docker, Terraform

 - CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions

 - Monitoring & Logging: New Relic, ELK Stack
   
    

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - Experience mentoring less experienced engineers and comfortable pair-programming with colleagues

 - Hands on experience with C# .NET and the latest features

 - Experience collaborating with front-end engineers and other disciplines to deliver end-to-end features and cross-functional epics

 - Experience working with identity and authentication systems (e.g. IdentityServer, OpenID Connect, OAuth2)

 - Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Spacelift or similar tools)

 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also valuable)

 - Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform

 - Strong experience with observability practices (logging, monitoring, alerting)

 - Familiarity with tools such as New Relic and ELK stack (or equivalents)

 - Curiosity about AI and emerging tools

 - Experience supporting production systems and improving reliability

 - Strong experience building and operating microservices architectures

 - Experience with event-driven systems and asynchronous messaging patterns

 - Solid understanding of distributed systems and scalability challenges

 - Have excellent communication skills



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact

That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Programme Manager to lead the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programmes that support Tesco Mobile Ireland's strategic objectives. Reporting to the Head of Business Operations, you will provide leadership across multiple initiatives, ensuring programmes are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

As a Senior Programme Manager, you will drive programme governance, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and operational readiness while ensuring business outcomes are achieved. You will also play a key role in establishing and embedding robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), driving continuous improvement and ensuring operational excellence across the business.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated programme professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys delivering meaningful change that improves customer, colleague, and business outcomes.

You will be responsible for

Leading the delivery of complex strategic programmes across multiple business functions.
Defining programme objectives, scope, success measures, roadmaps, and delivery milestones.
Establishing effective governance frameworks and ensuring programmes remain aligned with business priorities.
Managing programme budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and change controls.
Building strong relationships with senior stakeholders, delivery teams, and external partners.
Driving the development, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Ensuring new processes and operational changes are fully documented, approved, and successfully embedded into the business.
Identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency, quality, compliance, and customer outcomes.
Leading governance forums, steering committees, and executive reporting activities.
Working collaboratively with Technology, Digital, Customer Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Commercial, and Cyber Security teams to deliver successful outcomes.
Ensuring programmes meet all regulatory, governance, and audit requirements.
Tracking benefits realisation and measuring programme performance against agreed objectives
You will need

Significant experience managing large-scale programmes within telecommunications, technology, digital transformation, or similarly complex environments.
Proven experience delivering strategic change and business transformation initiatives.
Strong programme governance, risk management, change management, and stakeholder management expertise.
Experience developing and managing SOPs, process frameworks, and operational controls.
Excellent analytical, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and challenge senior stakeholders.
Experience managing third-party suppliers and delivery partners.
A degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience.
A recognised Programme Management qualification such as MSP, PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, AgilePM, or equivalent.
A passion for continuous improvement and delivering sustainable business outcomes.

Competitive Salary
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Bonus Scheme*

24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
